data: Is the blue dashed line in the left graph consistently increasing as the number of vertices increases?

The blue dashed line represents the graph size in the left graph. The x-axis shows the number of vertices, and the y-axis shows the size in MB. The blue dashed line starts at approximately 1000 MB when the number of vertices is around 300K and increases steadily as the number of vertices increases. It appears to be consistently increasing without any significant drops or plateaus. Therefore, the blue dashed line in the left graph is consistently increasing as the number of vertices increases.
